profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. presents itself on its Spanish website as an electric vehicle brand that has, since 2014, been turning what the world calls the future into reality. The site highlights three fully electric models, the G6, G9, and P7+, and states that they combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems, and an 800-volt platform called SEPA 2.0. According to the site, this platform allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. The three models carry the CERO label from the DGT and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160,000 km. The site names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller and notes that financing offers are subject to approval by Open Bank, S.A.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV, with SEC CIK 0001810997. No litigation cases are recorded for the company.
